A '''clone''' who served as a [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|shock trooper]] with the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] accompanied [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Stone (clone trooper)/Legends|Stone]] and several other troopers of the [[Diplomatic Escort Group]] with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Kharrus/Legends|Kharrus]] and [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] to [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]].

He survived the crash of their [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] after which he attempted to repair the shuttle's [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] but was unsuccessful. He along with all other clones survived the mission and departed Florrum aboard the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']].
